concept: RDS Multi-AZ: synchronous standby and automatic failover
tests: Which RDS configuration survives an AZ failure with automatic failover and synchronous replication.
expected: RDS Multi-AZ deployment: synchronous standby in another AZ, automatic failover. Triggers: "survive failure of an AZ", "automatic failover", "synchronous replication".
why_not: A cross-Region read replica is asynchronous, for DR/reads; Single-AZ has no standby; a bigger instance class adds no availability.
